subject: Taxes
title: Satoshi's Anonymous Design
description: A short lesson to help you apply Satoshi's Anonymous Design.

hook.text: Satoshi Nakamoto designed Bitcoin to be pseudonymous. No names, just wallet addresses.

buildup.text: Early Bitcoin users believed crypto was untraceable.

discovery.text: Every Bitcoin transaction is recorded on a public ledger forever.

twist.text: Chainalysis, a blockchain analytics firm, now helps the IRS trace crypto.

climax.text: Bitcoin's transparency is its paradox: every transaction is public and permanent.

punchline.text: Designed for privacy, recorded forever. Bitcoin's ledger is the IRS's best tool.

quiz.question: Why is Bitcoin not truly anonymous?
options: Every transaction is recorded on a public ledger permanently
